headline: White House Mulls New US Strikes on Iran Amid Tehran Missile Tests
subheadline: Iran launched ballistic missiles from Sanandaj and Parand while the White House evaluates fresh US strikes, heightening regional tension in the Middle East.
lede: Iran tested ballistic missiles from Sanandaj and Parand as the White House weighs renewed U.S. strikes, while Russia unleashed a wave of 15 Shahed drones and five cruise missiles across Ukraine overnight. Ukrainian drones damaged the Ryazan oil refinery, a key Russian fuel facility, and sank the Kapitan Shcherbakov refrigeration ship carrying 3,000 tons of frozen cargo in Avacha Bay. IDF forces seized over 340 weapons and destroyed a tunnel shaft inside a civilian home in the Beaufort‑Litani area.

sections.title: Ukraine Repels Massive Russian Drone-Missile Assault
sections.body: Russia launched 15 Shahed drones at Dnipro and five cruise missiles toward Zaporizhzhia, while Geran-5 missiles hit Kyiv’s Svyatoshyn and Vyshhorod districts. Ukrainian drones damaged the Ryazan oil refinery, a major Russian fuel facility, and sank the Kapitan Shcherbakov refrigeration ship carrying 3,000 tons of frozen cargo in Avacha Bay. Russian ground forces achieved tactical gains near Rusyn Yar in the eastern theater.

sections.title: IDF Seizes Weapons, Destroys Tunnel in Lebanon
sections.body: IDF forces captured over 340 weapons and demolished a tunnel shaft inside a civilian home in the Beaufort‑Litani area. Israeli artillery shelled the Mifdon locality in Lebanon, while strikes in Gaza killed one Palestinian and wounded others in Al‑Zawayda and Nuseirat. Iran conducted ballistic missile tests from Sanandaj and Parand as the White House considers renewed U.S. military action against Tehran.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Both Iran’s missile tests and the White House’s consideration of new U.S. strikes signal a potential widening of the Middle East conflict, while Russia’s large‑scale drone‑missile barrage and Ukrainian deep strikes on strategic assets indicate an expanding operational scope. The simultaneous advances in Donbas near Rusyn Yar and the sinking of a major Russian logistics vessel underscore heightened high‑intensity combat across multiple theaters.
